svg.title: GetStaticFilter, source by source
svg.desc: Animated: the filter for a TRAY footprint, built from one garage state in the four passes of the code. Each pass asks the CollisionTable where a tray cannot be because of something else and switches those poses and edges off.
svg.metadata: ["The garage state and the call: GetStaticFilter(TRAY, gg, dgs, ctable, ignore_trays = {T17}, ignore_agvs = {}, ignore_bays = {}). Tray T17 is the one being moved, so it is ignored. Trays K and T20 are parked, AGV-1 stands on W26, bay B21 is READY_TO_INSERT and node P24 is disabled.", "Pass 1, parked trays. For each tray not in ignore_trays, Query(tray footprint, TRAY, tray pose) returns every pose and edge where a moving tray would overlap it. K and T20 switch off their own nodes and the edges into them. T17 is skipped: it is the tray being moved.", "Pass 2, AGVs. AGV-1 is not ignored, so the area of an AGV at W26 is switched off for a tray. For a TRAY or payload footprint the code queries against TRAY, because an AGV meets a tray's legs before its payload.", "Pass 3, bays. A bay that is not READY_TO_RETRIEVE has its overdrive plate out, so its BAY_ODP volume is switched off: B21 itself and the approach from W41. A bay that is ready to retrieve is skipped entirely.", "Pass 4, disabled nodes. P24 is in disabled_nodes_ (or holds a disabled asset), so it is blocked at its largest window, PAYLOAD + max_resource_size_index, for every heading of the node, whatever is really there.", "Result: GraphFilterProperties(gg, disabled_poses, disabled_edges) starts with every vertex and edge enabled and sets the listed ones to false. A fifth pass runs only for payload footprints: nodes whose largest window is too small are switched off too."]

g.text: Map labels: P17, W22, B21, C14 = node_id 17, 22, 21, 14 (P parking, W waypoint, B bay, C AGV charger); T17 = tray_id 17; AGV-1 = agv_id 1; X@90 = GaragePose {node_id: X, heading: 90}, heading in degrees [-179, 180], 90 = facing -x.

g.text: GetStaticFilter: from garage state to graph masks

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: Nothing is removed from the graph: the filter is two boolean masks over its vertices and edges. Areas are plain rectangles with no buffer; the real sets come from CollisionTable::Query.
